text:
maya: quick async check-in for slice-0 -> slice-1 dry run. Started ramp to 1% at 09:12 PT, watching latency and error rate. doing a few warmup requests now.
liam: saw the deploy-bot msg, thanks. i'm running a smoke against the routing layer then will hit a handful of long-context prompts to warm kv cache.
sasha: good call on kv warmup. i pushed a tiny fix to the route-mapper CR (adds fallback to model-v2 when seq>1024). awaiting one more review from eva.
eva: reviewing now, should be green in 10m. no functional change, just a guard.
jon: FYI ops, we're using feature-flag ff.slice_zero_to_one that will flip traffic to the new slice. plan: 0% -> 1% -> hold 15m -> 5% -> 20% if healthy.
deploy-bot: canary started: slice-0 -> slice-1 at 1% (job_id: cb-3101234567). monitors: latency_p95, error_rate_5m, model_qps.
liam: quick sanity: curl to healthcheck returns 200 and header X-Serving-Slice: slice-1 for test request. command used: `curl -I -H "x-test-slice: slice-1" https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/health`
sasha: observed a small spike in p95 between 09:18-09:19 in prod-metrics, +40ms. looks correlated with a few large seq requests. not alarming but watching.
eva: if p95 keeps >100ms we should rollback to 0% and enable prefix cache. but right now it's 82ms on latest sample.
ops-oncall: watching infra. memory on gpool-17 saw a 3% bump but no OOMs. event loop latencies steady.
jon: question for product — is it ok to keep this canary running overnight if green? if yes we'll proceed to 5% at 02:00 PT. @maya
maya: product is ok with overnight on-call monitoring. just call me if we need to pause.
sasha: blocker: the telemetry pipeline dropped ~20 traces for this slice between 09:05-09:10 (trace sampler bug). that reduces fidelity for early window. i submitted a hotfix to observability repo, PR #482.
liam: can we add a quick synthetic to cover the missing traces? i can add a small harness to generate 50 traces over next 10m.
eva: +1 do it. it will help the regression alerts.
deploy-bot: alert: increase in model-inference-queue at 09:20 for slice-1 (+12 queued). auto-batching should absorb it.
jon: noted. liam, if queue persists >2m escalate to infra.
liam: will watch, if it doesn't drain i'll open infra incident.
maya: last note — product asked for a quick smoke on reranking route /v1/rerank before we move to 5%. can someone take that?
sasha: i'll run rerank smoke in 5m. command: `python tools/smoke_rerank.py --env prod --slice slice-1 --count 20`
eva: once CR merges i'm happy to lift flag to 5% after warmup window.
ops-oncall: thumbs on dashboards, ping me if latency or errors cross thresholds.
jon: thanks everyone. i'll post a short summary when we hit 5% or if we rollback. :thumbsup:
